main.bridge_claim_diagnosis: Links each claim line to its diagnosis codes in sequence, marking the primary; answers which conditions a claim line was billed for.
main.bridge_member_condition: Links members to the chronic conditions they have and when first seen; answers which ongoing conditions each member carries.
main.bridge_provider_facility: Links providers to the facilities they practise at and the affiliation type; answers where each provider works.
main.dim_claim_status: Reference list of claim status codes and whether each is final; answers what a claim status means.
main.dim_date: Calendar dimension with year, quarter, month, weekday and fiscal period per date; answers how to group or filter facts by time.
main.dim_date_bkp: Backup copy of the calendar dimension with fewer columns; not for analysis.
main.dim_denial_reason: Reference list of claim denial reason codes and whether each is appealable; answers why a claim was denied.
main.dim_diagnosis: Diagnosis codes with description, chapter, chronic flag and risk category; answers what a diagnosis means and whether it is a long-term condition.
main.dim_drug: Drug reference with NDC, brand and generic names, therapeutic class and specialty flag; answers what a medication is and whether it is a specialty drug.
main.dim_facility: Hospitals and clinics with type, bed count and location; answers where care was delivered.
main.dim_member: Current health plan members with demographics, location, plan tier and risk score; answers who the members are today.
main.dim_member_bkp: Backup copy of the member dimension; not for analysis.
main.dim_member_history: Full change history of each member with validity dates and version numbers; answers what a member's plan, address or risk looked like at a past point in time.
main.dim_member_old: Superseded copy of the member dimension; not for analysis.
main.dim_member_v2: Migration copy of the member dimension; not for analysis.
main.dim_payer: Insurance payers with line of business and plan type; answers which insurer covers a claim.
main.dim_physician: Physicians with NPI, name, specialty and state; answers who a doctor is and their specialty.
main.dim_place_of_service: Reference list of place-of-service codes; answers what kind of setting a service was delivered in.
main.dim_plan_sponsor: Employers or groups sponsoring health plans, with segment; answers which organisation sponsors a member's coverage.
main.dim_procedure: Procedure codes with description, category and relative value units; answers what a billed procedure is.
main.dim_provider: Providers with NPI, name, specialty, network status and location; answers who the providers are and whether they are in network.
main.dim_provider_old: Superseded copy of the provider dimension; not for analysis.
main.dim_provider_tmp: Temporary working copy of the provider dimension; not for analysis.
main.etl_load_log: Log of each warehouse load batch per table with row counts, timing and status; answers whether last night's loads succeeded.
main.etl_reject: Rows rejected during loading with the reason and raw content; answers what failed to load and why.
main.fact_claim_header: One row per claim with member, payer, status, dates, line count, billed, allowed and paid totals and adjudication time; answers claim-level amounts and turnaround.
main.fact_claim_header_new: Partial reload of claim headers; not for analysis.
main.fact_claim_line: The main claim line fact with member, provider, facility, payer, procedure, dates and billed, allowed and paid amounts; answers what was paid for which service, to whom, when.
main.fact_claim_line_bkp: Backup copy of claim lines taken on a date; not for analysis.
main.fact_claim_line_old: Superseded copy of claim lines; not for analysis.
main.fact_claim_line_tmp: Temporary working copy of claim lines; not for analysis.
main.fact_claim_line_v2: Migration copy of claim lines; not for analysis.
main.fact_claim_monthly_agg: Claim counts and billed, allowed and paid totals per payer, provider and month; answers monthly claim volumes and spend without scanning lines.
main.fact_denial: Denied claim lines with reason, date, appeal and overturn flags and recovered amount; answers which lines were denied, why, and what was recovered.
main.fact_encounter: Hospital encounters with admit and discharge dates, length of stay, DRG, and readmission flag and days; answers admissions, stays and readmissions.
main.fact_member_month: One row per member per month with eligibility, premium, capitation and risk-adjusted amounts; answers member months, eligibility and per-member cost.
main.fact_pharmacy_claim: Pharmacy claims with drug, prescriber, fill date, quantity, days supply, cost, fee, paid amount and copay; answers drug spend and dispensing.
main.fact_quality_measure: Quality measure results per provider per period as numerator, denominator and rate; answers how providers perform on quality standards.
main.stg_claim_line: Raw staged claim lines from the source feed before transformation; not for analysis.
main.stg_member: Raw staged member records before transformation; not for analysis.
main.stg_pharmacy_claim: Raw staged pharmacy claims before transformation; not for analysis.
main.stg_provider: Raw staged provider records before transformation; not for analysis.
main.v_chronic_members: Members with chronic conditions and the condition codes; answers which members live with long-term illnesses.
main.v_claim_line_as_of_service: Claim lines joined to the member's attributes as they were on the service date; answers what the member looked like when the service happened.
main.v_claim_line_current: Claim lines joined to the member's current attributes; answers claim lines by where the member lives now.
main.v_denial_rate_by_provider: Denied versus total claim lines per provider NPI; answers which providers get denied most often.
main.v_paid_by_month: Total paid amount by year and month; answers how much was paid out each month.
main.v_pmpm: Paid amount per member per month; answers the average cost per member per month.
main.v_readmissions: Encounters flagged as readmissions with length of stay and days since prior discharge; answers which patients came back soon after leaving.
main.v_service_lag: Days between service date and paid date per claim; answers how long claims take to be paid.
main.v_specialty_drug_spend: Pharmacy paid amount by therapeutic class for specialty drugs; answers spend on high-cost medicines.
